overview: The committee reviewed a proposed update to the city's vacant properties ordinance that would establish a commercial property registry and an escalating fee structure for long-term vacancies. The committee kept the matter in committee to allow for further drafting, increased public input, and a formal legal review by KP Law.

items.title: Vacant Properties Ordinance Presentation
items.summary: Chair Leming and Councilor Tseng presented a draft ordinance to modernize vacant building regulations by establishing a registry and an escalating fee structure ranging from $1,000 to $3,000. The proposal aims to incentivize property owners to fill storefronts and provide the city with reliable contact information for property managers.

items.title: Committee and Staff Feedback
items.summary: Councilors and city staff discussed the proposal's impact on development and the legal distinctions between fees and taxes. Board of Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor recommended requiring monthly pest control reports and a specific definition for 'local' property management radius.

items.title: Procedural Action and Referral
items.summary: Kept the ordinance in committee to allow for continued revisions and a request for a legal analysis from KP Law. The committee noted that moving the ordinance out of the zoning code will eventually require a recommendation from the Community Development Board.

subject: Vacant Properties Ordinance and Fee Structure
